_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: LIGHTNING_PLAYED_THIS_TURN. Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
